item.title: Martin Luther King Jr. Day: Chosen 300 serves steak dinners in West Philadelphia
item.description: Volunteers gathered at the corner of 40th Street and Lancaster Avenue in West Philadelphia on Monday to honor Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.’s legacy by serving meals to those in need. Honoring Dr. King’s message of service in West Philadelphia Chosen 300 Ministries hosted a special steak dinner outside its homeless shelter on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, welcoming anyone who needed a meal. item.description: Some of the coldest temperatures of the winter will grip the Philadelphia area on Tuesday, with bitter wind chills that will make it feel like the single digits.Temperatures on Tuesday morning will be below-freezing in Philadelphia and the suburbs, causing leftover melted snow to freeze on untreated surfaces.
